name: riprap
description: Riprap — mutuals as a protocol on Solana: permissionless protection pools, any terms, any lifetime. Frontend: @riprap/ui (illustration kit) + @riprap/landing (static site); on-chain: programs/pool (Anchor) + @riprap/pool (Codama client).

scripts.release:version: GITHUB_TOKEN="${GITHUB_TOKEN:-$(gh auth token)}" changeset version && cargo set-version --workspace "$(node -p 'require("./packages/pool/package.json").version')" && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.verify: pnpm -r run build && pnpm lint && pnpm -r run test && anchor build --arch v2 --ignore-keys && cargo test
